verdict.rationale: Scribe's own Text Polishing feature improves punctuation and capitalization. It appears to be an optional control, and the original transcript is kept separately under result. Number formatting and default formatting on the base transcript are not documented, and an explicit off switch is only implied by the 'polishing controls' mention. missing for 10: number/inverse-text-normalization formatting, evidence that base transcripts include punctuation/casing by default, an explicit documented toggle to disable formatting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off

citations.quote: Improve grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and readability
The original transcript remains under result and is never overwritten, and the complete polished text is returned under outputs.text_polishing.text.
with documented format, diarization, channel-separation, word timestamp, language, vocabulary, and polishing controls
